notes.note: Reviewed attached-session import checkpoint changes: synchronous individual events remain committed before publication, cursor advancement still follows the entire stored page, and ownership/attribution/deduplication are unchanged. Existing32-operation limits now also yield after16ms of monotonic elapsed work, resetting after the yield. Session API now states the bounded-work behavior without promising a hard latency. Real EventStore/cursor interleaving regression and83 follower tests passed; no provider/device completion inferred.

Region registration, pane identity, shellChrome/auth callback forwarding and occupied collapsed/center-owned conditions remain unchanged. Placement now explains the retryable lazy boundary and continued collapsed mounting. Existing 41 shell/region tests and UI typecheck passed; initial production JS is 311535 gzip bytes versus422419 before. Browser integration is still being verified.
